As the Executive Assistant, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our executives in various capacities. This position demands a proactive individual with exceptional organizational skills, creativity, and the ability to handle a wide range of responsibilities. The successful candidate will be a key contributor to our team's success, helping to drive client engagement, marketing efforts, and overall operational efficiency.

- Maintain confidentiality

- Strong organizational, time-management, and multitasking abilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Familiarity with managing social media platforms and content management.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
- Willingness to work in US time zones (PST, EST, CST).
